cards.networkDesc: For a business coordinating local rental companies and permitted shared inventory.

faq.headline: Questions about running your business with Revix.
faq.subtitle: Clear answers about the product direction, company structure, and current development stage.

items.q1: Is Revix System a rental marketplace?
items.a1: No. It is software being developed for rental companies to manage their own operations and connect permitted inventory to their sales channels.
items.q2: Can I use it for one company with multiple branches?
items.a2: Yes. The planned company structure supports one rental business with multiple branches, without requiring a network of local companies.
items.q3: How are local partner companies different from branches?
items.a3: A branch belongs to your company. A local partner company has its own workspace, team, and business data, with specific information shared through permissions.
items.q4: Can companies operate in different countries?
items.a4: The planned structure supports country-specific branch information, currencies, and time zones, independently of the interface language.
items.a5: Revix System is planned as a monthly subscription service. Final pricing and plan limits will be announced before launch.
items.q6: Can I connect my existing website?
items.a6: API access is planned for connecting permitted inventory with websites and partner platforms. Integration scope and availability will be confirmed before release.
items.a7: Revix System is currently under development. The interfaces on this page illustrate the planned experience and contain sample data.
